{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Emerald green silk midi dress, empire waist silhouette falling to mid-calf, deep jewel tone with hex code #50C878, fluid satin weave.
Charcoal wool-blend tailored blazer, structured shoulder cut with notched lapels, charcoal grey with hex code #36454F, fine tweed texture.
Pointy-toe leather ankle boots, moderate heel height of 6cm, matte black finish with hex code #1C1C1C, smooth calf skin.
Gold-tone hoop earrings and a delicate pearl pendant necklace.

This ensemble balances the romantic evening occasion with a practical outer layer suitable for autumn temperatures around 15°C. The emerald dress offers a vibrant pop of color that complements her warm skin tone while remaining elegant enough for a restaurant setting. Adding the structured charcoal blazer elevates the look to smart casual without overwhelming the outfit, creating a sophisticated yet approachable vibe for a first date."}
